narration_fil: Bumagsak ang isang nasa hustong gulang sa waiting area at hindi tumutugon. Nag-alok ng matamis na inumin ang kamag-anak.
narration_en: An adult collapses at the waiting area and does not respond when spoken to. A relative offers a sweet drink.

display_en:

narration_fil: Suriin ang paligid, tugon at normal na paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help at sanay na assessor. Kung hindi normal ang paghinga, sundin ang natutunang CPR/AED; kung humihinga, bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong.
narration_en: Check scene safety, response and normal breathing. Activate emergency help and request trained assessment. If not breathing normally, follow the locally trained CPR/AED response; if breathing, keep watching until help arrives.

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment. 2: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag magpakain o magpainom sa walang malay. Huwag manghula ng sanhi mula sa iisang palatandaan o ipagpaliban ang pagtawag. 3: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
check.feedback_en: 1: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 2: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person. Do not infer the cause of collapse from a single clue or delay emergency activation. 3: Prioritize safety and timely help.

narration_fil: Ganito ang ligtas na tugon sa kaso. Suriin ang paligid, tugon at normal na paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help at sanay na assessor. Kung hindi normal ang paghinga, sundin ang natutunang CPR/AED; kung humihinga, bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong. Iniiwasan ni Lea ang shortcut.
narration_en: This is the safe response in the case. Check scene safety, response and normal breathing. Activate emergency help and request trained assessment. If not breathing normally, follow the locally trained CPR/AED response; if breathing, keep watching until help arrives. Lea avoids the shortcut.

narration_en: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person. Do not infer the cause of collapse from a single clue or delay emergency activation.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.en: Give no drink to an unresponsive person.

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 2: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis. 3: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag magpakain o magpainom sa walang malay. Huwag manghula ng sanhi mula sa iisang palatandaan o ipagpaliban ang pagtawag.
check.feedback_en: 1: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 2: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis. 3: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person. Do not infer the cause of collapse from a single clue or delay emergency activation.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Ipakita ang ligtas na pagtawag, obserbasyon sa tugon at paghinga, at handover nang walang pagpapainom.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Demonstrate safe activation, response/breathing observation and an appropriate handover without oral intake.
